digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves and project-only criteria routing
propositions: A project-only criterion `project.symbol-reference-completeness` must be created to detect when plan source-code reference inventory was enumerated by hand or is demonstrably incomplete rather than derived from the symbol graph
The criterion must route to plan_review only (not code_review), because code-review's `applies_when` vocabulary is closed and a project.* criterion id can never fire a code-review move

The criterion must be advisory via `default_posture: "advisory"` with no `blocking_enabled` key, and the coaching move template must direct re-derivation using both `find_referencing_symbols` and string-literal sweep methods (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) that LSP cannot resolve

Code-review coaching moves were already overlay-driven via `.rebar/code_review_moves.json` in `load_move_registry`, so no engine wiring is required and shipped defaults for other clients remain untouched

The criterion detection fires reliably on incomplete hand-enumerated plans but is largely redundant with existing blocking built-ins (G1G2, G6, E4); the distinctive method coaching cannot reliably reach agents through LLM coach selection rather than configuration

Overlay assets must be tracked in version control and proven valid: the criterion id appears only under plan_review routing, nowhere in src/rebar/ defaults, and the move's `applies_when` references only the criterion id or applicable blocking criteria
